requests.title: Unify the authoritative M07 to M08 scenario identity and return context
conflicts: M07 OFW_M07_OPEN_M08 payload omits scenarioVersion and formedAt, while M08 requires both and rejects the actual payload.
M07 S005 resource carries S005-research-v1 and a fixed validation run id, while the canonical S005 contract requires S005-v1 and a newly formed S005-RUN identity.
The M07 manifest requires immutable forwarding of message.context, so reconstructing the identity in the host is a contract revision rather than a route-only adapter.
M07 writes a return position but does not read it back, and it always hands off the first series instead of the selected series.
requests.requiredDecision: Revise the handoff contract so the Composite host may retain the M07 business context while replacing its scenario identity with the active five-field authoritative scenarioContext, then freeze and validate the normalized payload before M08 delivery.
requests.candidateImplementation: The composite candidate implements a technical adapter in which M07 accepts the host five-field context, the host validates and freezes the normalized payload, selected series is preferred, and the exact return URL and position are restored. This is not a user or platform contract approval.
minimumClosure: The actual M07 runtime payload includes or explicitly permits host normalization of scenarioVersion, scenarioRunId, formedAt and status.
S005 M07 mount uses S005-v1 and the current S005-RUN identity without copying the fixed validation run id.
M07 selected series and exact return URL, lens, object and scroll position survive M07 to M08 to M07.
A cross-package test executes the actual M07 payload through M08 acceptM07Open for S005.

requests.title: Register an S005 InvestmentProduct objective in the M08 runtime catalog
conflicts: S005 requires an M08 modelingObjectiveRef and an InvestmentProduct input, but the M08 runtime objective catalog contains no S005 objective and returns no compatible objective for InvestmentProduct.

The M08 validation fixture declares MO-S005-POST-INVESTMENT-RESEARCH-v1, while the S005 package declares S005-POST-INVESTMENT-EVALUATION-RESEARCH-v1; neither value is registered in the API catalog consumed by the M08 workspace.
S005 uses PREDICTED and SIMULATED result kinds while M08 emits PREDICTION and SIMULATION.
The M08 workspace falls back to S001 case-study objects and series when an S005 handoff cannot resolve a compatible objective, which would replace rather than preserve the S005 context.
requests.requiredDecision: Choose one canonical S005 modeling objective id and one result-kind vocabulary, register the objective as compatible with InvestmentProduct, and adapt the M08 workspace to render its S005 inputs and result envelope instead of the S001 case-study defaults.
requests.candidateImplementation: The composite candidate uses MO-S005-POST-INVESTMENT-RESEARCH-v1 with PREDICTION and SIMULATION, filters objectives by the active scenario, and returns an unavailable state rather than another scenario or object's input. This is not a user or platform contract approval.
minimumClosure: The M08 objective catalog includes S005 and returns at least one compatible objective for InvestmentProduct with useKind=SIMULATION.
The S005 M07 handoff resolves to that objective without a compatibility error.
An incompatible or missing S005 input produces an unavailable-input state and never falls back to an S001 object or series.
The returned inputManifest and resultEnvelope retain the exact active S005 identity and do not write facts or overwrite archived scenario state.

requests.title: Migrate S003 model optimization ownership from the grandfathered M01 package to M08 resources
conflicts: The frozen S003-M01-DEBT-RISK-PKG@1.0.2 owns weights, factors and risk tiers as a Published model definition, while the platform-level Objective-first contract assigns Model Version, Benchmark, Experiment, Release, Binding and Shadow Trial to M08.
T019 remains an Ontology binding owned by M01 and cannot be reused as a model registry or release pointer.
The archived S003 scenario run and C035 FACT results must remain immutable while M08 research runs use independent BENCHRUN, EXPRUN and SHADOWRUN identities.
requests.requiredDecision: Confirm the future platform Owner and migration contract for S003 model parameters and release pointers while preserving M01 ownership of Published Ontology, Metric, Rule, Action Type and semantic contracts.
requests.candidateImplementation: The v1.2.0-rc.1 candidate wraps S003-M01-DEBT-RISK-PKG@1.0.2 as an immutable sourceRef/version/SHA baseline Model Version. M08 owns only research Objective, Benchmark, Insight, candidate branches, Release Candidate, Binding and Shadow Trial. No Published model, T019 model registration or production migration is performed.
minimumClosure: Platform governance approves the future Model Version and Release/Binding Owner split.
M01 remains the sole owner of Published Ontology, Metric, Rule, Action Type and T019 semantic contracts.
A separate implementation migration preserves the frozen 1.0.2 package, C035 FACT results and archived S003 scenario run.
This prototype CR does not create an approval workflow or block high-fidelity walkthroughs.
